status: MODEL / planning result of the board_gen planner (standard library); no KiCad board, no routing, no hardware result; bench gates OPEN

fill.label: MODEL: courtyard boxes of the vendored KiCad 10.0.7 footprints (F.CrtYd), not a routed board
fill.f2_trigger: PCB-PWRA-3/4 measures a PWR-A top fill above 0.60, or leaves refs unplaced or nets unrouted after two iterations; or H-TRIM fails at proof-fit (candidate s2nt: top raw fill 0.632); or a sourced part or block grows the PWR-A top demand by more than the 90.4 mm2 left below 0.60 (candidate shrink2)

bottom.label: MODEL: bottom side of the two-sided PWR-A; usable = outline - hole keepouts - thermal_bond zones - THT pin fields of the placed top parts + tht_margin (exact along x, rows of 0.05 mm)

f2c.reference: pcb/partition-budget.json candidates.shrink2.boards.PWR_A.demand_1_mm2 (the decided SHRINK-2 top demand, MODEL)

placement_checks.rule: per side, every placed courtyard box against every other one (anchor pairs: see anchors.errors) and against the reserved areas of that side; on side B also against the THT pin fields of the placed top parts + tht_margin

bottom.use: battery circuit (Mini-Fit Jr., 18 AWG), BMS and IP2368 leads

right.use: blower, BMS, CTRL harness S02 (JST PH, Micro-Fit); bottom-row ports and GX16 through plate slot SL3

top_sl2.use: rear-layer harness through plate slot SL2: J206 SL2-PWR-MF (S13, S14, S17, S18; Micro-Fit) and the battery-path S06/S07 leads to the rear-wall INA228 / #2813 (W2 MECH-3 routes); S04, S20-S22 and S35 leave from PWR-B J204/J207 (build/16-dzhgut-rozyemy.csv, W2 GR-3)

pwr_b_cutouts.rule: pcb/partition-spec.json height_rule and keepouts: courtyard + window_margin for parts taller than hA and for the PWR-A headers; a probe window of tp_probe_window for a test point

tht_pads.rule: every PWR-A THT pad and NPTH connector peg gets a plate relief pocket >= 1.0 mm and polyimide over the 0.4 mm gap (mechanical/params/boards.json tht_pockets); pin_field = pads and pegs; rows inside a thermal_bond zone also cut the Gelid pad

scripted_copper_precheck.label: geometry of the spec copper against the planned pads; KiCad fill, thermal spokes and neck widths are checked only on the routed board

b2b.rule: spec b2b pin_map: contact k of the PWR-A half on the PWR-A top under contact pin_map(k) of the PWR-B half on the PWR-B bottom, same net; MODEL geometry of the two KiCad 10.0.7 lands

positions.note: planned footprint origins (board mm, y up; align origin), the planner result above, not an acceptable placement for the group-placed refs

boundary.note: nets with pins on other boards that end on no graph connector pin of PWR-A

planned.note: SHRINK-2 changes that are not in the graph yet (status from pcb/partition-budget.json); the study counts their planned footprints and reserved blocks

turn_whatif.rule: each header turned by 90 degrees about its origin and set back onto the bottom edge; extent = courtyard length along the edge, depth = courtyard depth from the edge; the PWR-B edge strip over a PWR-A header is its depth + window_margin (pcb/partition-spec.json parameters)
turn_whatif.label: MODEL: courtyard boxes; not re-placed (a turned header changes its pin order along the edge and its harness exit, GR-5B/MECH-7)

h_trim.rule: H-TRIM (pcb/partition-spec.json keepouts.h_trim): PWR-A top parts under a PWR-B THT pin field + window_margin must be no taller than zone_h_max_mm; zones from the current pcb/boards/PWR_B.json placement (PCB-PWRB-2 re-places PWR-B); heights from pcb/partition-spec.json heights (MPN, footprint or class; TBD where none is read)
h_trim.cutout_note: PWR-A parts that need a PWR-B cut-out (pwr_b_cutouts) do not lie under PWR-B and are not H-TRIM parts; a current PWR_B THT pin field over such a cut-out is listed for PCB-PWRB-2, which re-places PWR-B against these cut-outs
